rules: Academy membership and physical presence are separate state.
A cadet on field training remains a cadet of the same current class unless a progression/membership event says otherwise.
Presence must later be constrained by authoritative schedule, travel and current-location state.
Player interaction cannot summon an absent cadet to campus.
Visitors may be present without belonging to Academy staff or cadet cohorts.
Temporary absence cannot be used to create a replacement duplicate cadet.
